# Philips N4520 Player v0.1.0

## Changes

- Refocuses the repository on the HACS-installable Home Assistant dashboard card.
- Moves the original standalone browser prototype into `standalone/` with local run instructions.
- Removes the experimental Music Assistant provider scaffold and related planning docs.
- Adds a cropped MP4 demo video for the README.
- Updates card metadata and status text away from the old Music Assistant provider framing.

## Notes

This release is tagged as `v0.1.0` so HACS can detect it through the GitHub
release version path used for dashboard plugin updates.
